Data Science
Bowling Green State University is widely recognized as having one of the best data science Ph.D. programs in the Midwest. In fact, it’s currently one of the few dedicated Ph.D. data science programs in the U.S.
BGSU graduates with a doctorate in data science are highly sought-after for top-earning positions as academic leaders, industry pioneers and policy innovators.
As a highly versatile discipline, data science leverages knowledge of technology, mathematics and communications to transform raw data into actionable insights in finance, healthcare, logistics, environmental protection and more.
With the rapid evolution of machine learning, AI and big data technologies, data scientists are redefining what’s possible – from decoding human genomes to optimizing global supply chains. In this data-dominated era, demand for data science experts will only continue to grow.
Program highlights
The pinnacle of expertise. A doctorate of data cience prepares you for competitive leadership roles in industry, government, academia and beyond.
Optimal career satisfaction. Data scientist is routinely ranked among the top five best jobs in the U.S. by Glassdoor.com, with a job satisfaction of 4.3 out of 5.
Exceptional faculty and peers. Learn from – and alongside – the best. This multidisciplinary program engages expert faculty from two BGSU colleges – the College of Arts and Sciences for mathematics, statistics and computer science and the Schmidthorst College of Business for applied statistics and operational research.
Graduate assistantships. Opportunities for graduate assistantships for the doctorate in data science – with scholarships and stipend – are granted on a competitive basis.
Balanced curriculum. The BGSU doctorate in data science includes classes in communication and responsible data use, ensuring graduates are well-rounded professionals. Doctoral data science candidates explore key considerations in gathering and analyzing big data and develop skills to effectively convey their findings to diverse audiences.

Career opportunities
A Ph.D. in data science from Bowling Green State University puts you at the forefront of some of the most exciting and lucrative career opportunities in the field of computer science.
A doctorate in data science primarily prepares you for one of two paths – academia or industry.
Data scientists with doctoral credentials for research and teaching roles are in high demand at universities across the country as the popularity of the master’s degree in data science has soared.
In public and private industry, those with a data science Ph.D. are needed as leaders in applied innovation.
Our curriculum prepares doctoral candidates for careers in which they may:
Develop machine learning models that can predict outcomes with unprecedented accuracy
Explore uncharted territories in artificial intelligence and big data
Contribute to ethical solutions that mitigate algorithmic bias and promote societal equity
Guide the next generation of curious, resilient and ethical data scientists
While graduates with a data science master’s degree are able to understand and utilize data science, doctoral students are ready to take the reins of leadership.

Curriculum
At its core, data science is about making sense of the world’s chaos. As one of the best Ph.D. data science programs in the country, the Department of Computer Science at BGSU prioritizes exceptional technical skill and moral philosophy in its curriculum.
On the technical side, computer science and statistics instructors teach students superior competency in core data science concepts and techniques. This includes analysis of structured, unstructured and dynamic data sets.
Doctoral students learn how to:
Organize data using tools appropriate to the problem
Code new techniques in the appropriate computer language
Optimize performance and scalability
Distribute new tools in a usable form
Given the growth and scale at which data science models are now applied and their many impacts on everyday life, ethical decision-making and clear communication are vital for practitioners in the field. Our Ph.D. in data science curriculum was specifically designed to identify and respond to ethical concerns of how and where complex data analysis is used.
Our graduates are experts in analytical method principles, as well as how best to convey the strengths and limitations of each to technical and non-technical audiences.
Culminating experience
Doctoral students must register for a minimum of 16 hours in Dissertation Research.
Required courses
Admissions prerequisites
The BGSU Ph.D. data science program builds on prerequisite coursework, including differential, integral and multivariate calculus, linear algebra and senior-level introduction to probability and statistics. Excellent skills in programming languages such as C, C++, Java and Python, as well as understanding of data structures and computer algorithms are also required.
Doctoral candidates ideally have a master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or a closely related field. Those admitted without sufficient background experience may be asked to complete the M.S. in data science program first.
Additional requirements include three letters of recommendation, resume and a statement of purpose.
See the admissions process and application requirements for more details.

Accreditation
Bowling Green State University [BGSU] is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission. BGSU has been accredited by the Higher Learning Commission since 01/01/1916. The most recent reaffirmation of accreditation was received in 2022-2023, with our next reaffirmation of accreditation scheduled for 2032-2033. Questions should be directed to the Office of Institutional Effectiveness.
